blocks.text: Organic compounds ke chemical reactions pecheeda (complex) hote hain. Inhein gehrai se samajhne ke liye hum yeh bunyadi baatein samne rakh kar aage barhte hain:

items: Covalent bond do tareeqon se toot sakta hai: homolytic aur heterolytic.
Reagents bunyadi taur par teen qism ke hain: free radicals, electrophiles aur nucleophiles.
Organic reactions ki kai aam qismein hain (neeche saat bayan hui hain).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan aur “C. Types of Organic Reactions” mein reactions ki “chaar” qismein kehti hai, lekin aage saat qismein (i–vii) bayan karti hai: substitution, addition, elimination, hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation aur reduction.
A. Covalent bonds ka tootna
Covalent bond do tareeqon se toot sakta hai:
i. Homolytic Fission (Homolysis)

Homolytic fission tab hota hai jab tootne wala bond nonpolar ho (dono atoms electrons ko barabar khenchte hon). Is mein bond ke do shared electrons dono atoms mein barabar bat jate hain: har atom ko aik electron milta hai.

blocks.alt: Homolysis ki do masawatein. Cl-Cl se nuqte wala Cl aur nuqte wala Cl; H3C-H se nuqte wala CH3 aur nuqte wala H. Har aik mein bond ke beech se do aadhe sire wale (single-barbed) mure teer nikalte hain, aik aik atom ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Cl-Cl aur H3C-H ka homolytic fission (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aadhe sire wala mura teer (fish-hook arrow) sirf aik electron ki harkat dikhata hai. Nonpolar bond ke do electrons barabar bat'te hain: har atom aik electron le jata hai. Is liye har hissa aik unpaired electron (nuqta) ke saath free radical ban jata hai: Cl• aur Cl•, ya •CH₃ aur H•.
Har atom ke saath laga nuqta (.) woh unpaired (akela) electron hai jo atom ko bond ke shared jore se mila.

blocks.title: Free radicals
blocks.text: Woh atoms ya atoms ke groups jin ke paas unpaired electron ho, free radicals kehlate hain.
Free radicals tab bante hain jab nonpolar bond toot'ta hai. Yeh reaction ke darmiyani (intermediate) species hain aur bohat reactive hain, kyun ke un ka akela electron jora (pair) banana chahta hai.
ii. Heterolytic Fission (Heterolysis)

Is tarah ke tootne mein bond ke do shared electrons dono atoms mein barabar nahi bat'te. Aik atom dono electrons rakh leta hai aur us par negative charge aa jata hai. Doosre atom ke paas aik electron kam reh jata hai, is liye us par positive charge aa jata hai.
Heterolytic fission tab hota hai jab tootne wala bond polar ho.
iii. Carbocation ka banna
Woh species jis mein carbon atom par positive charge ho, carbocation kehlati hai.
Carbocation tab banta hai jab carbon kisi aise heteroatom se jura ho jo carbon se zyada electronegative ho (electrons ko zyada khenchta ho), maslan O, N ya Cl.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is list mein “S, P” bhi likhti hai. Phosphorus (electronegativity 2.2) carbon (2.5) se kam electronegative hai, is liye yeh is list mein nahi aata; sulphur (2.6) taqreeban carbon ke barabar hai. Misal ke taur par O, N aur halogens (jaise Cl) sahi hain.

blocks.alt: (CH3)3C-Cl, beech wale carbon par teen CH3; carbon par +delta aur Cl par -delta, aur aik mura teer C-Cl bond se Cl ki taraf. Is se (CH3)3C+ (beech wale carbon par + charge) aur Cl- bante hain.
blocks.caption: (CH3)3C-Cl se carbocation ka banna (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Poore sire wala mura teer electrons ka jora (pair) hilata hai. Cl carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye C–Cl bond polar hai: C par +δ aur Cl par −δ. Heterolysis mein bond ka poora jora Cl le leta hai aur Cl⁻ ban jata hai; carbon ke paas aik electron kam reh jata hai aur woh positive ho kar carbocation ban jata hai.
Carbanion (jis carbon par negative charge ho) tab banta hai jab carbon kisi aise heteroatom (metal) se jura ho jo carbon se kam electronegative ho, maslan Li, Mg, Cd.
B) Reagents ki qismein

Do reactants ke darmiyan reaction ko aise samjha ja sakta hai ke aik species doosri par hamla (attack) karti hai. Hamla karne wali species reagent kehlati hai aur jis species par hamla hota hai woh substrate kehlati hai.
i. Free Radical
Woh atom ya atoms ka group jis ke paas unpaired electron ho, free radical kehlata hai, maslan Cl•, H•, •CH₃, CH₃COO•.
ii. Electrophile

Woh atom ya group jo naya bond banane ke liye electrons ka jora (pair) le sake, electrophile kehlata hai. Electrophile ka matlab hai “electron pasand”. Yeh ya to positive ions hote hain (carbocations samet) ya neutral molecules, maslan CH₃⁺, H⁺, Br⁺, NO₂⁺, SO₃, BF₃.
iii. Nucleophile

Woh atom ya group jo naya bond banane ke liye electrons ka jora de sake, nucleophile kehlata hai. Nucleophile ka matlab hai “nucleus pasand”. Yeh ya to negative ions hote hain (carbanions samet) ya aise neutral molecules jin par lone pair (bina bond wala electron jora) ho, maslan CH₃⁻, Br⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻, NH₃, H₂O, ROH.

Electrophilic aur nucleophilic ki istilahat (terms) sirf ions ke liye nahi. Bohat se organic compounds polar hain; un ke atoms par juzwi (partial) charges hote hain, jo unhein electrophilic ya nucleophilic bana dete hain.

blocks.text_alt: CH₃ (+δ, electrophilic) – OH (−δ, nucleophilic);   CH₃ (−δ, nucleophilic) – Li (+δ, electrophilic)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: CH₃–OH mein O carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye carbon par +δ hai: carbon electrophilic (electron jora lene wala) hai. CH₃–Li mein Li carbon se kam electronegative hai, is liye ulta hota hai: carbon par −δ hai aur woh nucleophilic hai.
C. Organic reactions ki qismein
Organic compounds ke reactions in qismon mein baante jate hain:
i. Substitution Reactions
Substitution (badalne wale) reactions mein do reactants is tarah react karte hain ke aik molecule ka atom ya group kisi doosre atom ya group se badal jata hai. Do products ban sakte hain. Maslan:
ii. Addition Reactions

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab temperature “200–300i” chhaapti hai; sahi 200–300 °C hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab propene ko “CH₂–CH=CH₂” aur product ko “CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–Br” (bromopropane) chhaapti hai. Propene CH₃–CH=CH₂ hai. Markovnikov’s rule ke mutabiq H us carbon par lagta hai jis par pehle se zyada H hon, is liye asal product 2-bromopropane, CH₃–CHBr–CH₃, hai; kitab ka apna Quick Check 19.6 bhi yahi deta hai.
iii. Elimination Reactions
Elimination (nikalne wale) reactions mein substrate molecule ke do saath wale (adjacent) atoms se atoms ya groups hat jate hain aur multiple bond (double ya triple) ban jata hai. Maslan:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab product CH₂=CH₂ ke neeche “ethane” likhti hai. CH₂=CH₂ ethene hai.
Elimination reactions ko addition reactions ka ulat (reverse) samjha jata hai.
iv. Hydrolysis
Hydrolysis mein compound paani se react kar ke do hisson mein toot jata hai; aksar H⁺ ya OH⁻ catalyst ki madad karte hain. Maslan:

blocks.text_alt: CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₃ (ethyl ethanoate) + H₂O → [H⁺] CH₃–C(=O)–OH (ethanoic acid) + CH₃–CH₂–OH (ethanol)

blocks.text: v. Condensation Reactions
Condensation reactions mein do molecules jur kar aik bara molecule banate hain; is mein koi chhota molecule, jaise H₂O, NH₃ ya HCl, nikal bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi. Maslan:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehle hydroxylamine propanone ke C=O par jurta hai (addition). Phir beech wale molecule se OH aur H (yani H₂O) nikal jate hain aur C=N bond banta hai. Is tarah do molecules jur kar paani nikalte hain: yahi condensation hai.
vi. Oxidation

Electron ka khona oxidation kehlata hai. Iske ilawa agar molecule oxygen le, hydrogen khoye, carbon ke oxygen ke saath bonds barh jayein ya carbon ki oxidation state barh jaye, to molecule oxidize hua.
vii. Reduction
Reduction woh reaction hai jis mein electron mile, oxygen kam ho, hydrogen mile, carbon ke oxygen ke saath bonds kam hon ya carbon ki oxidation state kam ho.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl ethanoate aur paani ka reaction kis qism ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis: paani ester ko ethanoic acid aur ethanol mein tor deta hai, H⁺ catalyst ki madad se.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Homolysis (nonpolar bond) se free radicals; heterolysis (polar bond) se ions: carbocations aur carbanions.
Electrophiles electron jora lete hain, nucleophiles electron jora dete hain.
Reactions ki qismein: substitution, addition, elimination, hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation, reduction.
